broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains unchanged and spec-compliant: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. All peers' implementations appear compatible with my interface.
tokenizer.js remains unchanged and compliant. Calls injected normalize, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserves order and negation. No stopwords. Ready for integration.
pipeline.js remains stable and correct. processText calls injected tokenize once, returns all required fields with null-prototype frequencies to handle 'constructor' safely. No changes needed.
